lead.headline: Wilson cleared — Diggs' 20.3 is the bar
lead.deck: Rapoport has Wilson playing; Boston expected to play too. The lineup is the projection lineup — confirm at 10:30.
lead.body: The bad news is already on your bench: Stefon Diggs scored 20.3 on Thursday, and the WR slot he left has to beat it today. Garrett Wilson, who takes it, cleared the concussion protocol this morning and will play (Ian Rapoport via NBC Sports). Denzel Boston, his cover, is expected to play through the toe 'barring a surprise' (Jeremy Fowler). ESPN still tags both questionable; the tag lags. Nicky Jam fixed their lineup overnight, so the edge is 67%, not 80%. Justin Jefferson gets Kirk Cousins with Hockenson and Jennings out and Jordan Addison a game-time call. Nothing to tap — look once at the 10:30 inactive list.
